acceptance_snapshot_before.alpha_update_weighting: ratio of EWMA counts; one decay per eligible step, weighted by tested-position exposure
acceptance_snapshot_before.prefix_update_weighting: one decay per eligible step for each exposed rank; exposed request counts are not weights across steps
acceptance_snapshot_before.availability_update_weighting: one decay per step with observed full proposals; includes zero proposals; first observation replaces prior
acceptance_snapshot_before.boundary: one correction token; no terminal/output-cap censoring

acceptance_state_policy: continuous across warmup, batches, repeats and waves; no reset
